content: Jesu thatna sik kinsepna
Nini makma Rakan Reikahoi le cholphillei waipol, Thiempu kolok ngai le Dan oja ngai ning Jesu kha ruk a surna sik khan that nasik lampui anlei entok.
Anmani ning anleiti, <<Hiwa reikahoi sunga hinchu thomiri, lakanchu mipui kinhangna ahong e thei.>>
Bethany a Jesu sarek ankanot

Bethany khopui-a chi kaomtak ri kaphar aleikoron Simon inna Jesu kha bu abak a alei omlai, numeisa inkhat lungwar ning anbol akok kisip akintheng nard kung ria ansom amankatam sarek anchoi a anheiwa. Khawanu ning sarek kok kha amalong a sarek rim kahoi kha jesu luchunga aleibun.
Khawa mun na mi alekchu anmulung aleithei a inkhat le inkhat anlei kinbek a anleiril, <<Sarek rim kahoi aminmang hi anemna angmi?
Hiwa Sarek hi sumsan reijathum kikhella nijor
thei e khan sumsan kha sara khodeng kathei ngai pethei e!>> khana numeinu kha anlei rilset je.
Tak Jesu ning aleiti, <<Khawanu kha abinga daru! Angsik mo ninkachok e? Numeinu hi ning akathatak kei sik a sin atho e.
Sara ngai chu nangnile nin ompui chak sik, nangni ning nin monom pha rikip a nin sen thei e. Takkha kei chu nangni le pha rikip a ombung nomin.
Khawanu ning ator seng kha atho e; Sarek rim kahoi kuchunga akanot hi kikinphum ning sik makma anakanot ijei.
Tunchu, akidik tak a kini rilpe hi-e simleichung pumpui chongkahoi kinrilna munna, khawanu ning aleitho ngaikha ama mindonna le kinroi a akinril sik e je.>>
Judas ning Jesu pesuoksik awanom
Khan thiemroi somle inni ngai karra Judas Iscariot antipa khaning Jesu pesuok nasik thiempu kolok ngai deng alei se je.
Anmani ning achong kha anjet pha anlei rokpui, sumsan pesik a kintepna annei je. Khawa jarra Judas khaning Jesu kha anmanideng pesuok thei nasik lampui alei-entok je.
Jesu ning athiemroi ngai rakan reikahoi bu abakpui

Chol phillei Waipol reihoi nikho amasatak ning, Rakan reikahoi bak nasik keelmong ngai that ning nikho khan, Jesu thiemroi ngaining anleirakal, <<Rakan rei bakbung nasik nangni jarra khon mo kinbol sik a nomonom?>>
Khan Jesu ning ankarra miring inni aleitirra hi-ang aleiminjet: <<Nangni khopui a son seru, khanna tuibel kodom mi inkhat ninkin tongpui sik. Ama kunuk kha jui ru
Ama lutna inn, kupupa deng khan tiru: <Oja ning ka thiemroi ngai le kei Rakan reikahoi kinbak nasik inn kha khon mi?>
Khawa pha amaning inn chungden kolok tak, aminleng sa inkhat ani min musik, khanna khan ang rikip eini sik a ninmintuk sik e.>>
Khawa munkha athiemroi ngai anlei mathaanli, khopui teng anlei se jei, khanna Jesu ning aminjet ang kopo-a angrikip anwamu je; khana Rakan reikahoi bakbung nasik a anmintuk je.
Kholei ahong tung pha, Jesu ning thiemroi somle inni ngai le an hong jei.
Anmani ning dokhang chunga anbak lai, Jesu ning aleiti, <<Akidik tak a kini rilpe e ninkarra kei le kinbakbung inkhat ning kei anape suok sik.>>
Athiemroi ngai ning anmulung aleidong a, inkhat soli inkhat ning, <<Kei nini tina chu imak nu, a-e mi?>> antia amadeng anleirakal.
Jesu ning aleimasang, <<Nangni somle inni karra inkhat, Kei le waipol kheeng sunga kinthun bungpa hi e.
Chong kinthenga aleikinje ang a, Miring Sapa kha athi nger sik e; takkha miring sapa akapesuok sik mipa kha angtuk mo amachal kase-e! Ama sik a alei kinte mak ning atha det sik e!>>
Puma janbu bakminchunna
Anmani ning anbak lai, Jesu ning Waipol her kha alei a Pathien nina le minpakna anei a, aher akhoi a, khan a thiemroi ngai deng aleipe, <<Kinlei ru, hiwahi kataksa e,>> aleiti.
Khan amaning hai kha alei a, Pathien minpakna anei a anmanideng aleipe; khana richu ankholo a anlei in.
Jesu ning aleiti, <<Hiwa hi mi katamtak sik a akolong, Pathien le kinnomna jetnasik kithisen kha e.
Akidik tak kiniril pe e, Pathien Rengram ma theiburju ther kha ki-in mak karseng hiwa theiburju hi inno ning jei.>>
Khan anmani ning laa ansak a, Olive chingtang teng anleise jei.
Jesu ning Peter akinlep sik arildik

Jesu ning anmanideng aleiti, <<Nangni ninkholo a nintaan sik khanna kei nana mathaan sik je, ajarchu chong kintheng ning ati, <Pathien ning keelmong kakhal pa kha athat sik, khan keelmong ngaikha ankin chek chai sik jei.>
Tak kei hi akiringa kathei nok li, Galilee a ninma a kalei se sik.>>
Peter ning aleimasang, <<Alak ngai sengning analei mathaan inum keining chu nada phit noning!>>
Jesu ning Peter deng aleiti, <<Keining nangdeng akidik tak kiniril pe e, atun jan tak hin arkhong ning woini akinram mak lai woithum rak kei hi jetmang niti sik.>>
Peter ning rasa kanger det-a aleimasang, <<Nang le nithi bung sik achang inum, kha-ang chu tiphit noning!>> Khana thiemroi ankholo-a kha-anga anlei ti rip.
Jesu ning Gethsemane a Pathien nina aleinei
Anmani ning Gethsemane anti munkhan anhong je, khan Jesu ning thiemroi ngai deng aleiti, <<Pathien nina kanei lai hiwa hin kin-ong ru.>>
Amaning Peter, James le John aleiroi. Khana kinrimna le mulung pongna achunga ahong tung je,
khana amaning anmanideng aleiti, <<Kumulung hi adong hei-a thina sik kutung a ije. Hinnahin om inlang kinrinchak ru.>>
Alek akalak det ase a, leithoi a akinbok-a, a ithei sik inchu khawa mulung pongna kha ama chunga asuok mak nasik a aleini.
Amaning aleini, <<Apa, Kapa! Nang sik-a angrikip a-ithei rip. Hiwa mulung pongna hai hi kei ria nakhek pe ro. Khanum kei lungdo ilei a, nang nulungdo e rase.>>
Khan ama ahong kirra thiemroi inthum ngai anleijal kha aleimu. Amaning Peter deng aleiti, <<Simon, nang najal mi je? Pung khatbei sik num akaher a om torlei mo ni-e?>>
Khan amaning anmanideng aleiti, <<Kinrinchak ru, mathemna ninta makna sik Pathien nina neiru. Ratha ningchu amonom, tak taksa chu adol.>>
Ama awasenok li Pathien nina, anga-ngai a aleineinok.
Khan athiemroi ngaideng ahong kirnok a anleijal kha aleimunok; anmit lei malong tormuk. Khana anmani ning anmanideng angmo arilsik leijet mak.

Woithum changna ahong kirnok a, amaning anmanideng aleiti, <<Nangni atun kutung ninlajal a pong ninla minchum mi? Ahun je! Apha kha ahong je! Enru, Miring Sapa kha setna kanei ngai kutchunga akinpe je.
Thei ru, eini se rang ri. Enru, anakape suok sikpa kha hin-na a-om je!>>
Jesu ansur

Jesu ning kha-ang chong arillai, thiemroi somle-inni ngai karra Judas kha ahongtung je. Ama le kinroi-a mipui ngai, Dan Oja ngai, upa ngai chemjamle luchei anchoi a thiempu kolok ngaining anhong tir je.
Akape suokpa khaning mipui ngai kha anjet nasik inkit inkhat aleipe: <<Keining komojop sikpa kha ninmanom pa kha e. Sur ru khan khal inlang keiso ru.>>
Judas ahei tunglimli, Jesu deng ase-a, <<Oja!>> atia awamojop.
Khan anmani ning Jesu kha ansurra khan ankhit tit je.
Tak amadonna akingir mi inkhat ning achemjam aheikalek a, Thiempu chungnung asokpa kuor atuk chet pe je.
Khan Jesu ning anmanideng aleiti, <<Muruk malet kusur sik anga chemjam le luchei kinroi-a kei kusur sik ninhong mi?
Aniso nangni le ni-ombunga Bek-inna kiniminchu jet, kei nalei sur muk chu. Tak Chongkintheng khachu pui alatung nger sik e.>>
Khan thiemroi rikip ngaining anmathaanli antan del je.
Pon kinnem bei kisil rother inkhat ning Jesu nuk aleijui. Anmani ning amakha sur sik a anleitho,
tak aponsil kha aleida li aroksai-a aleitaan.
Jesu upa rup ngai maikunga anleiroi
Khan anmani ning Jesu kha Thiempu Chungnung inna anroi je; khana khan thiempu kolok ngai seng le upa ngai khan Dan oja ngai le anlei kintup.
Peter ning alek kin-karra ahei jui, Thiempu Chungnung tollai sung a aheilut. Khanna khan raalmi ngaile anlei kin onga mei anlei otbung.
Thiempu kolok ngai le ankintup upa ngai seng ning Jesu that theina sik ajar anlei entok, tak inkhat te num leimumuk.
Jesu thothelna wartheng sakhi katamtak anril, tak ansakhi pe ngaikha ite leikin angmak.
Khan mi alek anhei ngir a Jesu thothelna hiwa wartheng sakhi hi anlei pe:
<<Keinining ama atikha kinjet, <Miring ning ansak hiwa bek-inn hi keining kithet sik, khan ni thum so-a miring ning ansak mak inkhat keining kasak sik.> >>
Kha achang inum anmani ngai sakhi pe kha leikin angmuk.
Thiempu Chungnung khaning anmani rikip maikunga angir a Jesu deng chong aleirakal, <<Anmani ning nang chunga thothelna anril hi masang lei sik mo ni-e?>>
Takkha Jesu ning a-omchena chong inkhat lei rilmak. Ret Thiempu chungnung ning Jesu deng arakal nok, <<Nang hi ralwan katha Pathien Sapa Messiah kha mo ni-e?>>
Jesu ning aleimasang, <<Kei ki-e, khana Miring Sapa kha akarat tak changteng akin-onga khana marwan sumphai le kinroi-a ahong chum kha ninkholo a ninmu rip sik e.>>
Thiempu chungnung khaning apon akeitherra aleiti, <<Eini ning sakhi alop rangai mak je!
Pathien arildek hi nangni ning ninjet je. Angmo ninmindon e?>> Ankholo ning amanom muk jei: anminthel a khan amakha nithat sik e anti.

Alek ning Jesu kha anleimichil thon anleiphut, khan anmani ning amakha amit ankhitpe a anleisuk. <<Najetmi atuning mo anasuk e!>> anmani ning anleiti. Khan raalmi ngaining anleiroi a amakha anleikaben.
Peter ning Jesu jetmong ati
Peter kha tollai a aleiom lai, Thiempu chungnung sok numeisa karra inkhat akolla aheiwa.
Soknu khaning Peter mei a-ot kha amu-a, alei en nganga aleiti, <<Nang num, Nazareth Jesu le ninlei kin roi.>>
Takkha Peter ning alei kinthing phirra aleimasang, <<Angkhami nangning niti kei jetmang,>> khan amaning inkhar tolteng aleise. Khawa laitak khan arkhong kha ahong kinram je.
Soknu khaning ama amu nok-a amodon na akingir ngaideng khan arilnok, <<Hiwa mipa hi anmani karra inkhat e!>> ati.
Takkha Peter akinthing phir nok je. Tomlak soa akolla akingir ngai ning Peter deng anleiti, <<Soilei-a nang anmani karra inkhat ni-e, ajarchu nang Galilee ria ni-e.>>
Khan Peter ning aleiti, <<Kei akidik kiril e, kikin hakser hi-e! Akidik kiril mak inchu Pathien ning nakarak rase! Keining ninril mipa hi jetmang!>>

Khawa laitak khan arkhong ning woini changna ahong kin ram je, khawa pha Peter deng Jesu ning aleiti, <<Arkhong woini ahong kinram mak lai nangning kei woithum rak jetmang niti sik.>> aleiti kha amindon jei. Khanna ama amulung kintok tak a aleichap.
